_doc: MERCS biome palette 'heartland' (06 section 2): the core ramps (core.json) plus this biome's ground, stone and sky (slate), soil, timber and foliage, and its light. From look option B 'Peat and Ochre', picked by the director 2026-10-15. Other biomes (kingdoms, landscapes) are new files beside this one with the same ramp names.

light._doc: Option B 'Peat and Ochre' lighting and post: low golden morning sun, warm brown ambient; night is a dim grey moon and a strong torch; light 4x4 ordered dither smooths the ramps. Sun and ambient energy +5% (director, 2026-10-15: "the lighting could stand to be 5% brighter").
